svg.text: MAPPING SOKET JST PCB MATRIX — REVISI 10-PORT BNC & 4 LPJ MANDIRI
Memaksimalkan Soket JST Terpasang (Hanya +1 JST 3-Pin Baru di B24-25) | Isolasi Pin Non-Strapping

g.text: 1. 4 LED LPJ (0 JST Baru): L1 di LPJ_BWH 1 (D26), L2 pakai eks HOUSE3-4 ➔ D12, L3 & L4 tetap di LPJ_BWH 3&4 (D33, D32). 4 Rumah digabung di HOUSE 1-4 ➔ D2.
2. 7 Jalur BNC Pakai JST Lama: BNC_A_SRC [4P] bawa A1(D4), SRC+(3V3+1kΩ), A2(D25), SRC-(GND). BNC_BC1 [3P] bawa B1(RX2), C1(D21), B2(TX2).
3. +1 JST 3P & Driver L298N: BNC_EXT [3P] bawa D1(D18), D2(D19), C2(D22). Soket [J] (D15) ➔ L298N 2 Motor DC. Saklar Toggle seri di 3.3V LDR.
